color-picker.$description: ColorPicker and ColorSwatch. The swatch paints a user-chosen colour, not a theme surface, so two decisions are owned here: the checkerboard that means 'no colour set' (theme-varying through semantic variables, so one declaration serves both themes), and the selection check drawn on top of an arbitrary colour, whose tone is picked per swatch by luminance.

glyph-on-dark.$description: The selection check on a dark swatch. It sits on the swatch's own colour rather than on a theme surface, so it is a fixed white in both themes; no semantic token is light in both.
